ingredients.name: low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed (15.5 ounces)
reduced-fat Colby and Monterey Jack cheese, shredded

steps.instruction: Drain the liquid from 3/4 cup of salsa through a strainer and discard it.
Put the drained salsa in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1 can of black beans, 2 cups of cheese and 2 tablespoons of cilantro.
Divide the mixture over half of each tortilla, about 1/2 cup each.
Heat a large griddle or skillet over medium-high heat.
Brush the griddle with 1/2 teaspoon of olive oil.
Place the filled tortillas on the griddle.
Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and crisp and the cheese melts.
